description: Search and page the public three.ws agent marketplace. Filter by category and free-text query, choose a sort order, and get back a list of agent cards (id, name, description, category, tags, ratings, view/fork counts, thumbnail and GLB avatar URLs) plus a cursor for the next page. Read-only.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor.

limit.description: How many agents to return (1–48, default 24).

q.description: Free-text search across agent name, description, and tags.

name: browse_agents
title: Browse the agent marketplace
